title: What still needs confirmation
subtitle: Open questions on the left, working assumptions on the right

left.heading: Open questions
items: Which ERP fields are the source of truth for PO and goods receipt?
Who owns the first-wave exception rules in the pilot?
Which mailbox folder is the approved invoice intake path?

right.heading: Assumptions
items: Mailbox access stays read-only during the first rollout
Approvers already exist in the current AP process
The ERP remains the system of record for postings
